verdict.rationale: Fivetran's REST API and MCP server support scripted/agent-driven management of many connections at once (e.g., copying connections to a new destination, a single hybrid-deployment agent managing multiple connections simultaneously, read/write/delete operations via MCP), which enables bulk automation across items. However there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated bulk-operation endpoint (e.g., batch create/update/delete across many connectors in a single call) or hands-on evidence of large-scale bulk actions being exercised. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints, documented examples of operating on many connectors/objects in one call, and independent verification of bulk-scale reliability.
